comment.narrative: Cumulated number of unique visitors on GACERE webpages on UNEP and UNIDO websites

In June 2022 UNEP created a GACERE landing page which is available at www.unep.orggacere. The landing webpage hosts all relevant information and documents related to the work of the Alliance. Details on the mandate and ambition of the Alliance can be found as well as the GACERE Concept Note and information on how to become a member or a strategic partner. GACERE working papers can be downloaded from the GACERE landing page. Details on past and upcoming GACERE events links agendas recordings etc. are provided. The list of members observers strategic partners and regional alliances with whom GACERE works are highlighted and regularly updated. The financial support of the European Union to the functioning of the Alliance is acknowledged. Cumulatively in 2022 the GACERE landing page has had over one thousand unique visitors.

title.narrative: Overall objective

description.narrative: To contribute to a global just transition to more climate neutral, resource efficient and circular economies for a more equitable use of resources to achieve sustainable consumption and production and more inclusive and sustainable industrialization, which aligns with the GACERE Concept Note, and that contributes to the 2030 Agenda, the Paris Agreement goals, halting and reversing biodiversity loss, and curbing pollution and waste, is supported and facilitated through a joint EUUNEPUNIDO partnership
